speaker_notes_constraints: Use the six workload names bisort, em3d, mst, perimeter, treeadd and tsp.
Describe the six as a fixed, auditable subset retained from pilot work, without claiming random or representative selection.
All six use ASan instrumentation, shadow memory and runtime support. Do not assign one program to only one ASan component.
Report ratio of mean ASan time to mean baseline time per program, arithmetic mean of six program ratios within each batch, then mean and sample SD across three batch summaries.
Each program/arm/batch has one warmup and five timed runs. Totals are 36 warmups, 180 timed executions and 90 timed pairs, with n=3 batch summaries.
Wall-clock timing includes startup, initialization and program output. Reference-output validation is outside timing.
Disclose requested malloc context depth 0 and effective depth 1 if discussing that setting.
This is a reduced-scale methodological and local-direction reproduction under different workloads, hardware and toolchain. Numerical equivalence to the paper SPEC result is not established.
Keep original formal main results separate from clean-entry acceptance and extension batches.
